prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Contracts for Cloud on Salesforce Summer 2019 User Guide

step.cmd: Open a template in X-Author Contracts.
From the left navigation pane, select X-Author Templates.
Go to Work tab> Insert Fields.
Place the cursor in the section of the template text, where you want to insert a field and click Insert New Fields.
In the Insert New Fields page, from the left column select the field's Object context (i.e., "Agreement"), then select object-qualified fields from the right column and click Submit.

postreq.p: The fields are inserted in the template. To view the inserted fields click Template Fields under the Work tab. Template Fields page shows the list of all the fields present in your current template. Select a field from the list to highlight it in the template document.
